brief: Declares a whole node topology as data, then runs it as real supervised processes on one machine or moves a node to another host.
detail: Node() makes a node current and the fluent calls On, Requires, Boot, AtHost, AtPort and InboxOf apply to it. A handler is a Ring code string, because code-as-data can cross an OS-process boundary where a closure cannot. Describe() returns the declaration as plain lists and StzNodeAppFromDescription rebuilds an identical app from it. RunLocal starts every node as a child process under a stzNodeSupervisor, all on loopback; Deploy moves a node by changing one host. The declaration methods are pure data and were run; RunLocal, StopAll and the running case of Deploy start processes and open ports, and were not run.
receiver:
o1 = new stzNodeApp("shop")
o1.Node("indexer")
o1.On("embed", "return aMsg[2]")
o1.AtPort(47001)
